styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Alcatraz, cable cars and the Golden Gate.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Mission burritos, Ferry Building and dim sum.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Coastal trails, redwoods and bay views.

stays.why: Central for shopping, cable cars and transit; easy walk to Chinatown and the waterfront.
Steps from Alcatraz ferries, Pier 39 and the cable car; family-friendly but touristy.
Close to Oracle Park, museums and BART; good value and quick airport links.
Best food and nightlife; sunny, walkable streets and BART nearby.

food: Get a Mission-style burrito in the Mission District; portions are huge, so share or go hungry.
Ferry Building Marketplace: sample local cheese, bread and coffee; check opening days on the day.
Chinatown dim sum is cheap and filling; go before noon for the freshest trays.
Cioppino (seafood stew) and sourdough bread bowls are the classic wharf dishes; expect tourist prices.
Book popular restaurants ahead; walk-ins are hard at dinner on weekends.
more_time: Swap a city day for Muir Woods redwoods or Sausalito by ferry; check tour and shuttle options on the day.
Add a Golden Gate Park half-day: gardens, museums and Ocean Beach at the end.
Take a ferry to Alcatraz; tickets sell out, so book well ahead.

recommend.why: Three nights covers Alcatraz, the Golden Gate and a food neighbourhood without rushing; add a day for redwoods or the coast.

month_notes: Jan: cool and wet, highs near 14°C. Pack a rain jacket and layers.
Feb: still wet, highs around 15°C. Indoor sights are a good bet.
Mar: rain lingers, highs near 15°C. Bring an umbrella.
Apr: drier and milder, highs around 16°C. Good walking weather.
May: mostly dry, highs near 17°C. Fog can roll in by evening.
Jun: dry but cool, highs around 19°C. Mornings are often foggy.
Jul: dry and mild, highs near 19°C. Fog is common near the coast.
Aug: similar to July, highs around 20°C. Warmest evenings inland.
Sep: often the sunniest month, highs near 21°C. Great for outdoor plans.
Oct: warm and mostly dry, highs around 21°C. A few showers late in the month.
Nov: cooler and wetter, highs near 16°C. Carry a rain layer.
Dec: cool and rainy, highs around 13°C. Pack warm layers and an umbrella.

climate_guide.summary: Mild and Mediterranean-style: cool, wet winters and dry, foggy summers. Rarely hot or freezing.

items.title: Best time: September to October
items.text: Warmest and driest months, highs near 21°C. Ideal for walking and the coast.

items.title: Wet winters (Dec–Mar)
items.text: Around 8–10 rain days a month and highs of 13–15°C. Bring a waterproof jacket.

items.title: Summer fog
items.text: June to August is dry but cool and foggy, highs 19–20°C. The coast is chillier than inland.

items.title: Layer up
items.text: Mornings and evenings are cool year-round. A light jacket helps every month.

items.title: Wind on the bridge and coast
items.text: The Golden Gate and beaches are windy and colder than downtown. Wear a windproof layer.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Comfortable walking shoes for hills, layers, a rain jacket in winter, and sunglasses for fog-free afternoons.

transit.best: Walk neighbourhoods and use Muni or BART for longer hops; skip a rental car in town.

modes.text: BART is the fast regional metro; Muni Metro covers the city. Buy a Clipper card to ride both.
Muni buses fill the gaps; use the same Clipper card. Slow at peak times.
Taxis are metered; Uber and Lyft are widely used and handy for late nights.
Driving is slow and parking is costly; skip a rental car in town.
The best way to see neighbourhoods, but hills are steep. Wear good shoes.
Ferries from the Ferry Building reach Sausalito, Tiburon and Alcatraz. Pay with Clipper.
Caltrain runs regional services; use the Clipper card.
